offering_description.value: Designs and sells orthopedic medical devices, including joint replacement implants, bracing, and rehabilitation products. Customers are hospitals, surgeons and clinics, and the company manufactures most products itself and sells them through its own sales teams and distributors.

primary_products.value: joint replacement implants; surgical instruments; orthopedic bracing and supports; rehabilitation devices; bone growth stimulators

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, orthopedic surgeons, ambulatory surgery centers, physical therapy clinics

revenue_model.value: product sales: implants, instruments, bracing and rehabilitation devices sold to hospitals, surgeons and clinics

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and manufactures implants and devices, sold to hospitals and clinics; brand owner: markets its own branded orthopedic products through direct sales and distributors

geography_served.value: global: sells in the United States, Europe, and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: reconstruction implants, bracing and softgoods, and rehabilitation devices sharing orthopedic surgeon and clinic customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales representatives calling on surgeons and hospitals; distributors / dealers: independent distributors in markets where the company has no direct sales presence

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices that need FDA clearance or approval and comparable approvals in other countries
